summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, private _Reader and _ReaderContext), added tests to tests/test_progress.py, added "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added a CHANGELOG.md Added bullet linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (783 insertions, 0 deletions) and nothing is committed. I could not run tests, mypy, or black, so everything is verified by reading only. Choices to review: the reader also defines mode, name, and truncate (needed for Python 3.6 abstract-method enforcement), the module open implementation types mode as Any to avoid an overload call error, and the suppressions are exactly those the spec lists, unconfirmed by mypy.
